thread:
Megan (Sales): MerchantCo sent PO+notes. They want Net-60, a software escrow clause, and e-signature routed via their bank signatory. PO#654321, total $120,000. Can legal/finance confirm if this is acceptable and what we need to close this week?

David (Legal): Net-60 is possible but requires a credit review and exec approval for new customers. For escrow, we need to agree on the escrow agent, deposited artifacts, and release triggers. Draft redline snippet I suggest: ```Escrow. Vendor shall deposit the source code and build instructions for the Platform with an escrow agent mutually agreed by the parties. Escrow release shall occur only upon (i) Vendor insolvency; (ii) Vendor failure to cure a material service outage for 60 consecutive days; or (iii) Vendor abandonment of the Platform. Costs of escrow shall be borne by Customer unless otherwise agreed.``` Need to confirm MerchantCo's escrow vendor.

Sam (Finance): We need the billing address, tax ID, and AR contact to match the PO. Net-60 ok pending credit check. For Net-60 on first-year deals we usually request a 10-20% deposit or an approved credit line. Who owns the reseller/resale? Is billing to MerchantCo US entity or their EU arm?

Megan (Sales): They say billing to MerchantCo Inc (US). They're pushing back on deposit because of their internal procurement cycle. Escrow is mandatory for them due to payments regs.

Raj (Eng): If escrow is required, we should confirm which components — runtime binaries only, or source + build chain? Also MerchantCo asked for customer-managed KMS/HSM for keys if we run in a VPC. That will change deployment/pricing and requires a support SOW for key handoff.

David (Legal): Customer-managed KMS we can do for Private and On-Prem only. For Hosted API we can't export keys. I'll add an addendum: "Customer-Managed Keys: Customer-managed keys are supported only for Private and On-Prem deployments; keys must be provisioned per Vendor runbook and Vendor will not have access to Customer keys." Also need indemnities and SOC2 attestation request.

Ellie (Ops): Signature routing: we accept DocuSign with full audit trail. If their bank requires a different e-sign method we need their bank's legal contact and chain-of-custody details. I can prepare a DocuSign envelope and route to their CFO after legal signs. @docusign-bot can create the template.

docusign-bot: Envelope created: env_2023_773. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_2023_773 (internal only). Template: Redwood MSA + Order Form + Escrow Addendum placeholder.

Sam (Finance): For invoicing, please confirm GL code and AR email. Proposed invoice lines: License (GL 43012) $100,000; Implementation/SOW (GL 52040) $20,000. Invoice to: MerchantCo Inc, Attn: Accounts Receivable, ar@merchantco.com. Also need their W-9 for US tax.

David (Legal): I'll draft the MSA redline with the escrow clause and KMS addendum and propose payment terms: Net-30 for first 30 days of service, then Net-60 thereafter upon successful credit check. If they refuse deposit, we can propose a parent guarantee or a purchase order-backed irrevocable letter of credit.

Raj (Eng): Note: customer-managed KMS adds ~2-3 days of onboarding engineering time + one SOW item for key rotation runbook. If they expect no additional fees, we need to flag costs to the customer.

Megan (Sales): MerchantCo insists on signing this week. I'm collecting their bank legal contact and pushing on deposit. Will they accept letter of credit instead?

Sam (Finance): LOI or LOC is acceptable as an alternative to deposit. I'll initiate credit check immediately.

David (Legal): I'll aim to share a redline by EOD today. Need bank legal contact and their escrow vendor name. If they already have an escrow agent (e.g., Ironclad/ESCROW-AGENT-X), attach their standard form.

Megan (Sales): Thanks — looping in MerchantCo contacts. I'll post their bank legal email and escrow vendor when I have it.

Ellie (Ops): Once legal approves the wording, I can attach the escrow addendum to the DocuSign envelope and route the signature chain: Redwood Legal -> MerchantCo Legal -> MerchantCo CFO -> Redwood Sales.

David (Legal): Sounds good. Quick checklist for close: (1) MerchantCo legal contact + escrow agent name; (2) AR contact + W-9; (3) Decision on deposit vs LOC; (4) Confirmation of Private deployment + KMS if they want customer keys.

Megan (Sales): I'll chase those items now. Thanks team, will update here when I have the documents from MerchantCo.
